diffs.diff: pressure (scaled raw Praw_sc, 24-bit two's complement / kP, default 1x oversampling kP=524288; Pa requires calibration coefficients): datasheet reading gives 0.0000019073486328125 per count, the part's model has -0.0004959, -0.002363, 1000, 1000
diffs.evidence: These two readings measure different things. The second reading's 1/524288 per count is only the datasheet's kP scaling (sec. 4.9.1: 'Praw_sc = Praw/kP'; table 9: '1 (single) 524288', '16 times (Standard) 253952'). The model's sim scale is hPa per raw count after full compensation, 'Pcomp(Pa) = c00 + Praw_sc*(c10 + ...)', using the sim's own coefficient registers: c00 = 0x186A0 = 100000 Pa, c10 = 0xF15A0 = -60000 (20-bit two's complement), and c01..c30 = 0. The driver's default pressure oversampling is 16x (kP = 253952), so hPa = (100000 - 60000*raw/253952)/100 = 1000 - 0.0023626512*raw. That matches the model's scale of -0.0023626512096774194 and offset of 1000 exactly. The -0.0004959 entry is the temperature measure. The 1000 entries are the MEAS_CFG status-register emulation (scale 1000), not a conversion. The simulator test passes (set 1005.3 hPa, read P=1005.30hPa).

diffs.diff: temperature (scaled raw Traw_sc, 24-bit two's complement / kT, default 1x kT=524288; degC requires calibration coefficients): datasheet reading gives 0.0000019073486328125 per count, the part's model has -0.0004959, -0.002363, 1000, 1000
diffs.evidence: Datasheet sec. 4.9.2: 'Traw_sc = Traw/kT' and 'Tcomp (°C) = c0*0.5 + c1*Traw_sc'; table 9 gives kT = 524288 for 1x (single). The second reading's 1/524288 is only Traw_sc per count, before calibration. In the model's sim coefficient registers, c0 = 0x0C8 = 200 and c1 = 0xEFC = -260 (12-bit two's complement). The driver's default temperature oversampling is 1x, so degC = 100 - 260*raw/524288 = 100 + (-0.00049591064453125)*raw. That is the model's scale and offset 100, i.e. exactly c1 times the 1/524288 from the second reading. The -0.002363 entry is the pressure measure, and the 1000 entries are the MEAS_CFG status emulation. The simulator test passes (T=18.40C).
